answer: By the meadow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The raven lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the karst is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, expired if not renewed by fresh work, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
